item.title: DynoSure SLCANv1 - USB to CAN Adapter
item.description: The DynoSure SLCANv1 is a compact, high-performance USB-to-CAN adapter built for automotive engineers, embedded developers, and testing professionals. Based on the CANable2 firmware and the Lawicel SLCAN protocol, it exposes the CAN interface as a standard virtual COM port - making integration seamless with zero driver overhead.

item.title: DynoSure SLCAN GPIO - USB to CAN Adapter with GPIO Control
item.description: The DynoSure SLCAN GPIO combines a full-featured USB-to-CAN adapter with 8 configurable GPIO outputs, giving you CAN bus communication and hardware control in a single compact device. Built on the CANable2 firmware with the Lawicel SLCAN protocol, it appears as a virtual COM port and integrates seamlessly with BUSMASTER and other CAN tools.

item.title: DynoSure LoggerV1 - Standalone CAN 2.0B Data Logger
item.description: The DynoSure LoggerV1 is a standalone CAN bus data logger designed for the Indian automotive industry. It captures CAN 2.0 traffic to onboard storage in the standard Vector ASC file format - no proprietary software, no vendor lock-in.

item.title: DynoSure OBD to DB9 Converter
item.description: The DynoSure OBD to DB9 Converter provides a universal and reliable connection between your vehicle’s OBD-II port and your USB-to-CAN tools (including the DynoSure SLCANv1, SLCAN GPIO, and LoggerV1). Built to industrial quality standards, it ensures robust communication and seamless power delivery.
